title: Common branded-primitive definitions for @intentsolutions/core schemas
description: Shared $defs referenced by every entity schema and the gate-result/v1 predicate body. Branded primitives correspond to the TypeScript brands in src/primitives.ts — at the JSON Schema level, they are pattern-validated strings/numbers.

uuidv7.description: UUIDv7 — time-ordered 128-bit identifier (RFC 9562). Time-ordered prefix means natural sort order matches insertion order. Per Blueprint B § 6.2 universal conventions.

sha256.description: Bare 64-hex-char SHA-256 digest. Used for entity content_hash fields per Blueprint B § 2.x prose.

sha256Prefixed.description: Prefixed SHA-256 digest in the form `sha256:<64-lowercase-hex>`. REQUIRED format for every *_hash field in the gate-result/v1 predicate body per Blueprint B § 7.4. Unknown algorithm prefixes cause row verification failure.

rfc3339.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone. Blueprint B requires UTC ('Z') with millisecond precision for fields in worker-lease ordering (clock-skew tolerance ±10 ms).

actorIdentity.description: Opaque actor identity string — engineer email, service-account name, or worker id. Format intentionally unspecified at this layer.

storageKey.description: Object-storage key (content-addressed). Format opaque at this layer; storage backends own resolution.

otelSpanId.description: OpenTelemetry span identifier — 16 lowercase hex characters per OTel spec.

microUsd.description: Cost in micro-USD for sub-cent precision. Per Blueprint B § 2.12. Convert to USD at display layer (value / 1_000_000).

mmClass.description: Matcher Map class — closed v1 canonical set per Blueprint B § 2.3. Extension via FailureTaxonomy proposed→canonical lifecycle (Class-1 ISEDC).

mmClassId.description: FailureTaxonomy natural key — accepts any MM-N value (broader than MmClass enum since taxonomy is upstream of kernel enum).

runnerIdentifier.description: Tool + SemVer identifier in the form `<kebab-slug>@<semver>`.

commitSha.description: Git commit SHA — full 40-hex or short 7-hex accepted per Blueprint B § 7.4 line 815.

subjectName.description: in-toto subject name per Blueprint B § 7.3 line 779. Three segments: `<tool>:<side>:<gate-id>` where side ∈ {client, server, ci, sandbox, local}.

coverage.description: Coverage declaration per Blueprint B § 7.4 line 807. Both arrays REQUIRED. NOT_APPLICABLE encoding (§ 7.4 line 832): gate_decision='pass' + populated dimensions_skipped + documented skip in gate_reasons.
